name: background/light-sweep-pass
title: Light Sweep Pass
desc_vi: Một vệt sáng chéo quét qua khung một lần, mọi thẻ sáng lên và đổ bóng theo ánh sáng, rồi ánh sáng dừng ở vị trí nghỉ ở 1/3 phía trên.
params_vi: angle: góc (115°) · sweepAt: giây bắt đầu quét (0.9) · strength: standard | subtle · accent: mã màu · scene: cards | plain · band: inside (vệt sáng chỉ chạy trong các thẻ, mặc định) | frame (quét cả khung như bản gốc HF)
notes: Same structure as the source: one number (--light-x) owns the whole pass and static CSS (calc/clamp/max) turns it into the band translate, each lit element's highlight and shadow, and the ambient lift; the proxy that writes --light-x each frame is a ctx.code block (-35 -> 118 over 1.6 s sine.inOut at sweepAt, then 118 -> 62 over 0.55 s power2.out). The band opacity and the stage settle (0.5 s, 1.5 % of height) are literal tweens (band uses opacity, the source used autoAlpha). cq units became px from the frame size; var(--token, fallback) became the fallback colours; accent is a colour (default #22c55e, the source green fallback). The source slot is replaced by scene 'cards' (the source default hero + 3 cards, drawn without text) or 'plain'; lit elements must be inside the block and carry data-lit and --lsp-x. The source exit variable, retime scaling and sound cue are not ported. ae is png: per-element shading by CSS calc and a screen-blended band cannot be rebuilt in After Effects as keyframes. will-change on the stage layer keeps the seek check stable (raster noise of the blended gradients otherwise). Gallery review 05/10: the user wants the light inside the cards, not over the whole frame: param band, default inside (each data-lit element gets a frame-aligned copy of the band, clipped by the element); band frame = the source behaviour.
